question: On Monday morning a call-out engineer had 97 minutes of work booked in his diary. Before lunch one customer added 8 minutes to a job and the office booked him another 31. In the afternoon a further job added 13 minutes, and in the evening a night call added 72 minutes. The company charges 9 cents for every minute the engineer works. The invoice is written in cents rather than in dollars. How many cents will the booked work come to?

Gustav's fruit farm has 174 rows of blackcurrant bushes, with 3 bushes standing in every row. A disease swept through and killed 189 of the bushes. Every bush that survived carries 7 sprigs of fruit, and each sprig holds 3 berries. Gustav's partner Isla, who tends fewer rows than he does, picked 5887 berries for the jam kitchen. How many berries are still on the bushes?

On Sunday morning the village fete's tombola table held 105 prizes. Before ten o'clock a shop donated 35 more and a family brought in 39. During the late morning 15 prizes were won and carried away, and in the afternoon a further 77 went to winners. In the early evening the raffle organiser transferred 80 unclaimed prizes onto the tombola table. Each prize left on the table was then wrapped with 4 strips of tape for storage. A dozen bunting flags hung over the stall. How many strips of tape were used?

A conference organiser ordered 208 tables, and 200 of them went straight into the main hall, leaving the rest for the small workshop room. Each workshop table seats 6 delegates, and every delegate is given 8 handouts. Each handout runs to 8 printed pages. The printer then pulled out 451 pages that had been duplicated by mistake. The venue is 12 kilometres from the airport. How many pages are there in the workshop handouts?

On Monday morning a workshop counted 221 rolls of wire in the store, and every roll measures 8 metres. During the afternoon the team cut each metre into 7 short pieces. In the early evening every piece was bent into 2 hooks, and each hook was then dipped 6 times into the paint tank. The paint tank was installed 3 years ago. How many dips into the paint tank were made?

A cider maker had 173 bottles racked in the cellar and a friend brought round 31 more. A second pressing then tripled the number of bottles in the cellar. All of them were packed equally into 4 crates ready for the market. A delivery van took 28 bottles out of the first crate on the way. How many bottles are in that first crate now?

A festival ordered 226 wristbands and then asked the printer for 75 more. The printer doubled the whole order as a goodwill gesture, so the festival received 2 times what it had asked for. Half of the wristbands were sent straight over to the second gate. The main gate was then given 71 spare wristbands from last year's stock and 44 from a sponsor. Just before the gates opened the organiser had the main gate's supply doubled again, leaving it with 2 times as many as it had been holding. The festival runs for 3 days. How many wristbands does the main gate have?

On Thursday morning a hotel had 128 clean pillowcases in the linen store, and housekeeping added 18 more straight from the dryer. Before lunch 74 were taken up to the guest rooms. During the afternoon a coach party's rooms used another 46. In the early evening the laundry returned 21 pillowcases, and later that night a delivery brought 39 new ones. How many pillowcases are in the linen store?

A prepaid phone card started the month with 206 minutes on it. One long call home used up 178 minutes, and a run of short calls used another 25. The provider then ran an offer that replaced the balance with 5 minutes for every minute still on the card. A dropped call wasted 2 minutes, and a refund for that fault added 30 minutes back. The card is sold in minutes rather than in hours. How many minutes are on the card now?

On Monday morning a labelling plant received 222 pallets, with 8 crates on every pallet and 5 boxes in every crate. During the afternoon the staff found 8 jars packed in each box, and every jar needs 7 labels. In the evening the machine ran out of stock and fell 338335 labels short of what the jars needed, and a small back-up printer produced 62 labels before the shift ended. The plant's log is written in minutes rather than in hours. How many labels were printed?

A school shared 156 tennis balls equally among its 6 PE classes. Mr Adeyemi's class was then given a second set exactly the same size as its share, so it held 2 times as many balls as the other classes and more than Ms Bright's class ever kept. 20 of the balls went over the fence during the term and were never found. Every ball the class still had was used in 5 practice drills, and each drill was repeated 3 times. How many drill repetitions did the class run?

An olive oil producer filled 105 cases with 6 tins in every case. A neighbour added 72 loose tins to the same store. A festival order then took 400 tins away, and 18 came back unopened after the event. Every tin in the store earns a regular customer 9 loyalty points. The barn roof was mended 4 years ago. How many loyalty points do the tins in the store represent?

Jonas had 79 comics on his shelf and sold 40 of them at a collectors' fair. He lent another 14 to a schoolfriend who never brought them back. His sister Mira then gave him a bundle exactly the size of what he had left, so he held 2 times as many comics as before, though Mira kept fewer than Jonas did. He passed 15 on to a jumble sale and bought 52 at a second-hand shop. How many comics does Jonas have now?

On Monday morning a laundry had 120 bags of washing waiting on the floor, and a hotel sent 65 more before lunch. During the afternoon the staff counted 8 items inside every bag. In the evening the machines got through half of all those items, and the rest waited until morning. Each item that was washed was then pressed with 5 strokes of the iron. The laundry van is 6 years old. The price list is written in cents rather than in dollars. How many strokes of the iron were needed?

A gym instructor taught 45 classes last month, and each class began with 7 minutes of warm-up. Across the month she also spent 40 minutes on stretching demonstrations. Cooling the classes down took a further 46 minutes in total, and she logged 39 minutes of paperwork. Her timesheet is kept in minutes rather than in hours. How many minutes did the instructor log for the month?

Dara had a dozen fishing floats in her tackle box and found 3 more in the shed. Her friend Ola gave her 64, far more than Dara had owned to begin with. Every float in the box was then fitted with 3 tiny beads to weight the line. A spare packet in the box already held 47 loose beads. How many beads does Dara have for her floats?

On Tuesday morning a car wash had 159 bookings on the sheet, and 9 more were phoned in before the gates opened. Every booking takes 9 minutes of machine time. Later that morning the work was split equally among the site's 3 lanes. In the afternoon lane one picked up an extra 40 minutes of work, and in the evening another 30 minutes were added to that lane. The water company charges 6 cents for each minute a lane runs. The site has 12 parking bays. The bill is written in cents rather than in dollars. How many cents does lane one cost to run?

A community fridge held 93 ready meals on Monday morning, and 66 were taken during the day. A supermarket then delivered 70 more, and 69 were collected by families that evening. A second fridge was filled to match the first, so the scheme held twice as many meals as it had before. A lunch club used 41 of the meals, and a caterer donated 56. The volunteers' rota is written in minutes rather than in hours. How many meals does the scheme have?

Ravi ordered 16 sheets of plywood for a shelving job and sent 4 back because they had warped. His workmate Dana, who ordered fewer sheets than Ravi did, cut every good sheet into 8 shelves. Each shelf was then drilled with 3 fixing holes. The workshop wall already had 15 holes drilled for the same job, and the second wall had 29. A dozen clamps hang on the rail by the door. How many fixing holes are there for the job altogether?

A youth theatre had 51 scripts in the office and the writer printed 54 more. A local school lent the group 60 scripts, and the library donated 38. 174 scripts went out to the cast and crew for rehearsals, and 19 were lost somewhere backstage. A dozen chairs were set out for the first read-through. The rehearsal schedule is written in minutes rather than in hours. How many scripts are left in the office?

On Saturday morning a market gardener cut 176 bunches of flowers, and her helper Tom cut 37 more, fewer than she had managed herself. During the afternoon every bunch on the bench was tied with 4 stems of foliage. In the early evening a florist dropped off 32 spare stems and a neighbour brought 21 more. A late order then took 105 stems away. How many stems of foliage are left?

A podcast studio had 220 minutes of tape in the cupboard and bought 59 minutes more. The first episode used up 160 minutes. The studio then recorded a duplicate of everything it had left, so the cupboard held 2 times as many minutes as before. Every minute of tape was copied onto 7 discs, and each disc was burned 2 times over for the archive. The studio log is kept in minutes rather than in hours. How many disc burns were made?

Priya's orchard has 95 apple trees, and every tree carries 7 fruiting branches. Each branch holds 6 clusters, and every cluster has 8 apples on it. Her neighbour Otis, who tends fewer trees than Priya does, added 43 apples from his own tree to her crop. Each apple in the crop will be pressed into 5 spoonfuls of sauce. A dozen ladders lean against the barn wall. How many spoonfuls of sauce will the crop make?

A tannery cut 37 hides, and every hide was divided into 8 panels. Each panel was then split into 2 strips, and every strip was stamped with 5 metal studs. A quality check afterwards found 1677 studs that had worked loose, and all of those were taken out. The tannery yard is 40 metres long. How many studs are still in place?

A community choir sold 238 tickets for its winter run in the first week. The corner shop sold another 21, the website took 38, the box office sold 64 on the door, and a coach party bought 44. The ticket holders were then divided equally among the 3 evenings of the run. A dozen singers stand in the front row. How many ticket holders are booked for one evening?
